blocks.text: The K&H Pet Products Pet Cot raised dog bed keeps your dog elevated and off the ground allowing air to flow around your pet to keep them cool. The easy to assemble elevated pet bed requires no tools! Can be disassembled and taken anywhere. Our raised dog bed is great for camping, hiking, picnics, or anywhere at home inside or out. Made with water-resistant, heavy denier fabric and a breathable mesh center that repels moisture. The cover is removable and washable or can be hosed off outdoors. Slip-resistant rubber feet help protect floor surfaces. The K&H Pet Cot is durable and can hold up to 200 pounds; the X-Large & Jumbo sizes can hold up to 300 pounds. Indoor or outside use. Available in multiple sizes and colors for any size dog and cats too: Small dogs/cats 17" x 22", Medium dogs 25" x 32", Large dogs 30" x 42", and Extra-Large dogs 32" x 50". Jumbo XXL dogs 56" X 38".

items.label: ELEVATED DOG BED COT
items.value: Raised dog bed helps pets stay cool in spring and summer months by allowing air to circulate and keeps pets off wet/cold ground with 7" ground clearance keeping your dog off the ground away from dirt, bugs, ticks, ants, etc

items.label: INDOOR & OUTDOOR USE
items.value: Lifted pet bed with breathable mesh center is great for indoor and outdoor use; slip resistant rubber feet provide protection for indoor flooring and water resistant mesh center repels moisture and odors

items.label: HEAVY WEIGHT CAPACITY
items.value: Our large dog cot boasts a lightweight metal frame and heavy denier cover, supporting over 200 pounds with ease, perfect for large dog breeds

items.label: EASY CLEAN-UP
items.value: Dog hammock features a removable cover that is machine washable or hose off the cover for quick clean-up outdoors; simplifying maintenance for busy pet parent

items.label: EASY TOOL-FREE ASSEMBLY
items.value: Collapsible outdoor dog cot is easy to assemble and disassemble, no tools necessary making this portable bed great for use at home or during travel, camping, picnicking, place cot for dog training and more

items.label: COLORADO BRAND YOU TRUST
items.value: Designed by K&H with 25+ years of experience in creating safe, innovative, quality products for pets, ensuring safe reliability and top-tier craftsmanship for pet parents

items.label: SIZE
items.value: Large dog cot bed measures 30 X 42 X 7, perfect for large sized breeds like: Labrador Retriever, German Shepherd, Golden Retriever, Doodle, etc

items.label: Other Special Features of the Product
items.value: Cooling, Elevated, Washable, Breathable, Non Skid Bottom, Portable, Lightweight, Scratch Resistant, Removable Cover, Water Resistant, Travel

items.label: Product Benefits
items.value: Keeps pets cool, durable, easy tool-free assembly, machine washable, elevated and suitable for indoor/outdoor use

items.label: Product Care Instructions
items.value: Remove the cover from the frame. Machine wash cover only, separately. Mild detergents, no bleach. Cold water, gentle cycle. Air or line dry. Dry completely before reassembly.
